effects.label: Deflection
effects.description: Redirects a percentage of all incoming damage from the recipient of the buff to the caster of the buff. The recipient takes the remainder of the damage as normal.

effects.label: DEF Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Defense stat by the indicated percentage.

levels.text:
Charges 1 enemy in a 8m radius, tracking them for 5s. 
If Caladras reaches the target, attacks 10 enemies in a 5m radius, from a distance of 8m, dealing 85 damage. Casts a [30% DEF Down] debuff on the targets, lasting 8s. bio: The Wild Kings of the Eldrin have always been more… enthusiastic… than others in the Royal Conclave, but Caladras takes that reputation to a whole new level. First into the fray, Caladras fights in a frenetic frenzy of fire and mayhem, and that’s how he stays until end of the victory feast.
